description: This file contains utility functions for handling F1AP ASN.1 messages, including extracting message types, transaction IDs, and paging information, as well as mapping error causes to strings within the ocudu namespace.

methods.name: get_cause_str
methods.description: Returns a string description of the F1AP cause based on its type.

methods.name: get_message_type_str
methods.description: Returns a string representing the type of the F1AP PDU.

methods.name: get_transaction_id
methods.description: Extracts the transaction ID from various F1AP message types.

methods.name: get_gnb_du_ue_f1ap_id
methods.description: Retrieves the gnb_du_ue_f1ap_id from different F1AP message structures.

methods.name: get_gnb_cu_ue_f1ap_id
methods.description: Retrieves the gnb_cu_ue_f1ap_id from different F1AP message structures.

methods.name: get_paging_ue_identity_index_value
methods.description: Extracts the UE identity index value from a paging message.

methods.name: get_paging_identity
methods.description: Retrieves the paging identity (IRNTI or TMSI) from a paging message.

methods.name: get_paging_identity_type
methods.description: Determines the type of paging identity present in a paging message.

methods.name: get_paging_drx_in_nof_rf
methods.description: Returns the DRX cycle in number of RF blocks from a paging message.

methods.name: get_paging_priority
methods.description: Returns the priority level of a paging message.
